  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  February 26, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Community Room “A” 1st
Floor. On February 26, 2026, at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call:  Members Present:
  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Angel Leon-Martell, Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Services Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department

  Staff Present:
  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on February 12, 2026

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Savanna Fiehler on behalf of American Red Cross to host a Sound the Alarm Smoke
  Installation Event at 9717 S Inglewood Ave; Public Property, on Saturday, February 28,
  2026, 2026, from 8:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one
  (1) day event at Siminski Park. Subject to Parks and Rec approval for use of the park.
  Applicant responsible for crowd control and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC
  regulations; Applicant to have a minimum of two (2) professional licensed security guards
  for the safety of staff, volunteers and attendees. Security shall wear reflective vests to be
  readily identifiable. IPD watch commander will be notified of this event. Extra patrol-high
  visibility will be provided as time permits. None conditons for Code Approval; None
  conditions for Fire Approval; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly
  immediately at the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall
  follow all social distancing, protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety
  guidelines set forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department;
  and Adhere to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code
 Permits & License Committee  February 26, 2026

  rules and regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00426563)

Item #2:  Chan Gigi on behalf of Los Angeles County Fire Department to host a Pancake Breakfast
  Event at Fire Station #171 at 141 West Regent Street, Public Property; on Saturday, April
  25, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for one
  (1) day event within Fire Station #171 on Regent Street and Fir Avenue. Subject to Public
  Works approval for use/closure of the right-of-way. Applicant responsible for crowd control
  and event cleanup. Subject to all applicable IMC regulations;There will be two (2) IPD
  officers deployed to this event for public safety. Four (4) TCO's will be needed for the street
  closures around the event. **This will be a joint-partner event with the city for the purposes
  of staffing cost (which will be covered by the city).** Meridian barriers will be needed for
  street closures.. None conditons for Code Approval; None conditions for Fire Approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is cleaned correctly immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene, and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00426568)

2026 - New Business License Request (s):
Item #3:  Kelvin Piste on behalf of Hair Stadium to operate as a Hair/Nail Salon Business at 4549 W
  Century Blvd., APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees;Business owner must
  possess and maintain valid and current Establishment License from the State Board of
  Barbering & Cosmetology; Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating
  within the establishment must possess applicable licenses from the State Board of Barbering
  & Cosmetology;Cosmetologist's, Barbers, Esthetician's and Manicurists operating within the
  establishment is required to register and file business tax with the City;Business owner shall
  provide valid and current government-issued identification and copies of applicable state
  licensing on all employee(s) and/or any person operating within the establishment to the
  Finance Department;Parties, social events or gatherings of any type is strictly
  prohibited;Consumption of alcoholic beverages, narcotic drug use (including cannabis
  activity) is not permitted on the premises; Massage therapy of any part of the body is not
  permitted; Subject to random inspections by any City Code Enforcement Officer or any Peace
  Officer at any time to ensure compliance; Adhere to all State, Federal and Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage.Failure to comply with
  any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation of your business license and
  any future business license application requests. Motion carried unanimously (Activity
  No. 00426381)

Item #4:  Brandon Moore on behalf of MBM Parking Solutions to operate as a Parking Lot Business
  at 945 S. Prairie Ave; APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six month will negatively impact your license renewal;Remittances of
 Permits & License Committee  February 26, 2026

  Parking Tax by the 20th of each month following collection;Approval for Special Event
  Parking Forum events only;Special Event Parking must not start before 6 pm Monday
  through Friday;On Site business must be closed 1 hour before Event Parking starts.Parking
  attendant or security guards must be on site during event parking at all times; Ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site and; No Tailgating; Adhere to all State,
  Federal and Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in revocation of
  your business license and any future license application requests. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00426566)
